text: Final scenario: You are the senior SOC analyst during a major incident involving phishing, a compromised user, malicious PowerShell, credential theft, lateral movement, domain administrator access, command-and-control traffic, and possible data exfiltration. Walk me through how you would investigate, contain, eradicate, recover, document, and communicate the incident from beginning to end.
expected_concepts: Investigate: identify phishing victim, timeline, malicious payload; analyze PowerShell for C2/tools; track credential theft method and scope; map lateral movement paths; identify compromised systems and DA access; analyze C2 infrastructure and exfil targets
Contain: isolate compromised accounts and systems; block C2 domains/IPs; disable compromised credentials; prevent further lateral movement; preserve evidence
Eradicate: remove malware/tools from all affected systems; close attacker access paths; patch vulnerabilities exploited; reset all compromised credentials; review and remove persistence mechanisms
Recover: restore systems from clean backups if needed; verify system integrity; monitor for reinfection; gradually restore services; implement enhanced monitoring
Document: maintain detailed timeline; preserve evidence and logs; document IOCs, TTPs, and scope; capture lessons learned; create incident report

Communicate: brief leadership on status, impact, and remediation; coordinate with legal, PR, compliance teams; notify affected users/customers if required; provide regular updates to stakeholders; conduct post-incident review with team
